title: Airborne times of 127 long-haul routes, both directions, with filed flight plans (FlightAware)

radius_enters_via.how: planned distance filed by the airline, computed on the WGS84 ellipsoid (stored, not used for the radius)

verdict_rule: Southern round trips that take about twice as long as equally long northern ones, as the flat map's distances require; or times that fit the flat map's distances better than the globe's.
license_note: FlightAware public flight pages (https://www.flightaware.com), read 2026-09-28, 2026-11-06 and 2026-11-25 (three windows of about two weeks, kept together); check FlightAware's terms of use before re-fetching on a large scale.

sources.cite: FlightAware, public flight pages (actual wheels-off / wheels-on times, filed flight plans, airport reference coordinates)

units.off, onT: Unix time, s (UTC), actual wheels-off / wheels-on
units.ab, ba: hours airborne, one value per kept flight
units.oc, dc: [lon, lat] degrees, E and N positive (FlightAware reference point)
units.plan.wpt: [lat, lon] degrees of the filed lat/lon waypoints

inputs.origin: Our list of airport pairs and callsigns (one entry per route), chosen for long routes in every direction.
FlightAware public flight pages of each callsign, read 2026-09-28, 2026-11-06 and 2026-11-25 (fog fetch avia-flights): wheels-off and wheels-on times, filed flight plan, airport coordinates.
inputs.checks: Flights without both times or with a diversion are dropped and counted by the build.
inputs.caveats: FlightAware's times come from ADS-B and airline messages; a mislabelled leg or a wrong time zone on their page would pass through.
inputs.refetch_why: FlightAware shows a flight's history for a limited time, so fetching again gives other flights, on other days. The values used (wheels-off and wheels-on times, filed routes and speeds, airports) are in src/data/presets/avia-flights.js, generated from these files, with this file's hash in its header.

notes: Edit routes.json only (one entry per airport pair, ICAO callsigns each way), then fog fetch avia-flights, fog lock avia-flights, fog build avia-flights. The times, the airports' coordinates (angles), the waypoints and the filed true airspeed (a speed through the air, from Mach and temperature, not over the ground) carry no radius: the radius of the avia tab uses only those, so it is a measure. The filed distances do carry one and are flagged above, which is why the dataset as a whole is a check.
public_raw_why: FlightAware's terms of use do not allow republishing what is read from its pages.
